name: Export USD
description: Opens a downloaded Blendkit .blend, unpacks its packed textures, flattens shader node groups and exports a self-contained UsdPreviewSurface .usd file. Optionally also emits standalone MaterialX (.mtlx) materials plus a name-keyed mapping JSON alongside the .usd.

params.name: max_resolution
params.description: Texture resolution cap: 512/1024/2048/4096/8192/ORIGINAL. Picks the textures subfolder suffix.

params.name: export_mtlx
params.description: Also export one standalone .mtlx per material into <stem>_mtlx/ and write <stem>.materials.json mapping material names to their .mtlx files (for high-fidelity material binding in Maya/USD). Requires the MaterialX Python module bundled with Blender 4.1+; skipped gracefully if unavailable.
